reuse_rule: Attach typed governing operators to existing Alexandria/CCC/Raphael capabilities; never duplicate owners, solvers, physical authority, source files or global inventories.

operator_families.kernel: d(rho)/dt + div(rho*u)=source; flux and storage close by boundary
counterexamples: Tracking a fragment is not capturing it
Reusing mass-flow graph cannot assume equal phase or chemistry
Non-Newtonian resin cannot be modelled from one Newtonian mu
Knudsen rarefaction and Mach compressibility break ordinary liquid-flow assumptions

operator_families.kernel: r,v in inertial/reference frame; two-body epsilon=v²/2-GM/r; intervention requires force/delta-v and conserved momentum
counterexamples: Geometric alignment does not grant capture
Putting ice ahead of a target in orbit does not cause passive stable deposition

operator_families.kernel: incident + supplied + released-stored power = received/harvested + outgoing + dissipated + delta-storage
counterexamples: Backscatter does not recapture all escaping radiation or generate net energy
Sunlight is broadband; no solar universal frequency
Schumann resonances cannot substitute for a high-bandwidth communications channel

operator_families.kernel: transport depends on field, boundary, phase, permeability, equilibrium and controlled gradients
counterexamples: A small controlled gradient cannot guarantee stable ecological system
particle capture mechanisms differ across metal/dust/chemical pollutants

operator_families.kernel: source evidence + typed relation + right/ACL + time/coordinate qualifiers
counterexamples: A bit is not a joule
semantic equivalence is not conservation-law or physical identity
lossy summary must not replace original R0 source

operator_families.kernel: source -> conditions -> independent test -> owner ACL and receipt -> accepted scope
counterexamples: AU location does not grant SAI authority
A verified upstream Git blob does not authorise redistribution or deployment

prohibited_promotions: Do not label arbitrary space debris/ice orbital collision as safe natural absorption or stable capture
Do not imply offset regolith deposition alone manufactures a planet or biosphere
Do not identify information bits with joules or material particles without a physical encoding/cost model
Do not imply passive EM reflections can cancel all escaping radiation or return harvested energy without a source and link budget
Do not replace broadband Internet/verified radio link with Schumann/ambient noise resonance analogy
Do not auto-enable Australian SAI, foreign networks, autonomous missions or physical actuation based on a semantic graph
